scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @eventdesk/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,scanner,admin -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @eventdesk/api dev" "pnpm --filter @eventdesk/scanner dev" "pnpm --filter @eventdesk/admin dev"
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @eventdesk/contracts build && pnpm --filter @eventdesk/admin build && pnpm --filter @eventdesk/scanner build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @eventdesk/contracts build && pnpm --filter @eventdesk/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @eventdesk/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @eventdesk/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @eventdesk/scanner typecheck
